source.display_title: 05/27/2026 - David Wingfield x Harry Edmonds — Closed

prospect.name: David Wingfield
prospect.occupation: Maritime technology sales — director of the global government team; heavy international travel (Turkey, Brazil, repeated trips to Washington DC), often at short notice
prospect.family_status: Engaged, marrying on 2 August with the honeymoon in Mexico the next morning; fiancée has two young boys, Matteo (6) and one aged 4; they plan to have children soon and are not yet living together
prospect.training_background: Training consistently for about six years — bodybuilding-style work and CrossFit, neither of which stuck. Travel is the stated breaker: hotel gyms have no barbells and he will not modify the programming himself. Mobility has degraded badly under CrossFit-style compression work — he cramped attempting the bridge in Trevor's free five-minute morning routine. Self-reports ADHD and losing interest in programmes after about three months. Wants a home gym eventually but does not want to wait for it.
prospect.medical: Self-reported ADHD ('I have ADHD so I get bored with it pretty quick'). No injuries, conditions or medications disclosed. Reports severe loss of flexibility and cramping when attempting a bridge, described as a mobility deficit rather than an injury. Alcohol intake two to three drinks a month.

signals: Already in reasonable shape and wants better: '220 at 6'2", about 18% body fat... I'm not in like terrible shape, but it's more of a rebuild the mass, like regain the muscle mass that I have'
Price was never an objection and he pre-empted it: 'It's not a money issue for me. I guess I'm not worried about that part, but the philosophy'
Senior professional with a global remit who buys to remove friction, not to be rescued
Bought on philosophy and fit rather than pressure — the one part of the pitch he reacted strongly to was the education-and-exit model

goals.text: Fit his suit and be as lean as possible for the wedding on 2 August — 68 days away
Get from ~18% body fat toward 13%, ideally 10-11%, before the honeymoon in Mexico
Rebuild the muscle mass he used to carry, especially shoulders and upper body
Have his fiancée be proud of who she is standing next to on the beach
Be a role model through his own actions for two stepsons and children to come — 'that impressive superhero dad'
Be healthy and around long enough to play with and coach his kids
Regain flexibility and mobility — he cannot currently complete Trevor's free morning routine
Something he can stay consistent with while travelling constantly, without a barbell or a full gym
A programme that stays interesting enough that boredom does not end it at month three

pains.text: Constant short-notice international travel breaks every programme he has tried
Nothing has stuck — bodybuilding and CrossFit both abandoned
Programmes require barbells and full gyms he cannot access on the road, and he will not do the modification himself
Loses interest once the hyperfocus passes, which he attributes to ADHD
Mobility has collapsed — cramped attempting a bridge while his fiancée did it easily
Diet slips when travelling with a boss who wants to go out drinking
Does not enjoy cooking for one and eats the same simple meal repeatedly when alone
Watching his six-year-old stepson gain weight and lose activity in the weeks he spends with his less active father
Work is high pressure and unpredictable — 'usually it's quite stressful'

offer.guarantee_mentioned: 'We guarantee you that from the start, let's say your starting weight is 35 pound... the guarantee is that by the end of the six months you'll be swinging around a 20 pound heavier kettlebell in all the movements as well. That's the only best way we can guarantee results for everybody.'

evidence: Chose the six-month tier unprompted with a reasoned rationale: 'I think probably the six months. Because I'm not coming in completely novice as far as health and fitness'
Confirmed on the close question: 'How do you feel about all of that?' / 'Sounds good to me' and 'You ready to rock and roll... for 68 days?' / 'Yeah, she's ready'
Onboarding call with Trevor scheduled live for Monday at 12:15pm Central, with the rep trying to pull it to the weekend; email and phone number both given
Payment collection began on the call — 'in terms of the payment, did you want to do it on Visa, MasterCard, credit card?' — and the prospect went to find his wallet

Counter-evidence: payment is not confirmed within the transcript. The rep stopped the recorder before the card was taken: 'let me just remove the recorder as well... Don't want to record your info.' The $6,000 figure is the tier agreed, not a confirmed receipt
Zero objections were raised at any point in the call
outcome.next_step: Onboarding call with Trevor booked for Monday 12:15pm US Central (rep to attempt to move it earlier); full protocols promised within 24-48 hours of that call

notable.note: The only close in the batch, and it came from the most ICP-core, least price-sensitive prospect on the list — no objection of any kind was raised, and no discount, payment plan or alternative tier was needed. Worth noting the guarantee he bought is denominated in kettlebell weight over six months while the thing he is actually buying is a body composition change in 68 days for his wedding. Also note the recording is deliberately stopped at the point of payment, which means no transcript in this corpus can evidence money actually changing hands.

quality.notes: The labels are inverted from the first line — 'Hey, Harry, how are you doing?' is attributed to Harry — and stay unreliable throughout. Long merged blocks at 00:12:00-00:13:00, 00:34:00 and the entire pricing exchange put both speakers under one label, and 'Trevor's in California, but I'm in London' is attributed to the prospect when it is the rep. Roles resolved from content; the prospect is in Houston, the rep in London.
